description: Aquatic Form 20% of base mana Instant Requires Druid Requires level 16 Shapeshift into Aquatic Form, increasing swim speed by 50% and allowing the druid to breathe underwater. Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects. The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.
name: Aquatic Form
